trial.jaymospowers.kill_power: Fell %s hostile creatures with your power
trial.jaymospowers.deep: Go down into the deep dark (below Y -40)
trial.jaymospowers.high: Stand up among the clouds (above Y 200)
trial.jaymospowers.thought.done: %s. Further than I thought I could go.
trial.jaymospowers.thought.swap_back: A job done clears my head: I could think of something else to push at.
screen.jaymospowers.trials.all: You have pushed past every limit you could think of.
screen.jaymospowers.trials.waiting: Nothing comes to mind yet: learn more of your power.
screen.jaymospowers.trials.how: Your own thoughts on how to push your limits. Each done is mastery; finishing any quest gives a swap back.
message.jaymospowers.brink: At the edge, something in you wakes a little. It is closer now.
message.jaymospowers.trade.no_power: You have no power to trade.
message.jaymospowers.trade.face: Face the one you would trade powers with.
message.jaymospowers.trade.offered: You hold your earring out to %s: trade powers? Both of you must say yes twice.
message.jaymospowers.trade.asked: %s would trade powers with you: sneak and use your earring facing them.
message.jaymospowers.trade.again: Both of you are willing. Sneak and use the earring once more to be sure.
message.jaymospowers.trade.waiting: %s is sure. Sneak and use your earring once more to trade.
message.jaymospowers.trade.failed: The earrings hold nothing to trade: both of you need one in hand, and a different power.
message.jaymospowers.trade.done: The earrings crack. %s is yours now, and it starts again from its first ability.
